synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — a net-cash, still-growing, FCF-positive franchise at a historic-floor multiple, set against sharply negative forward revenue revisions and multi-year margin erosion.

bull_points.claim: The stock trades at TEV/LTM EBITDA 4.0x, the 0th percentile of its own ~5-year range of 8.0–57.2x (median 16.2x), a near-floor de-rating not seen before in its history.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Multiples (Close; last col = current, excluded from history)

bull_points.claim: Revenue is still GROWING, not contracting: FY25 +15% and Q1-26 +7.6% YoY, with absolute EBITDA RISING across the trailing arc (693→707→731) even as the margin % compressed — the % decline is not falling absolute profit.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: On the fundamental decomposition versus peers, the name posts BETTER growth (rev 14% vs peer-median 1%; EBITDA growth 6% vs 2%) and LOWER leverage (Debt/EBITDA 0.4 vs 1.5) — inputs that pose whether the discount is RESIDUAL (overshoot) rather than fully EARNED, though a heterogeneous peer set gates confidence.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bull_points.claim: The balance sheet is net-cash at net-debt/EBITDA -1.0x with LTM FCF of $692.9M positive, so the business is self-funding and not survival-constrained on an LTM basis.

bull_points.claim: The company is buying back stock — share count fell 8.2% over ~1.7 years (56.9M → 52.2M) — a capital-return posture, not distress behavior.
Credit-health scoring places the name stronger than peers on every axis (Overall/Operational/Solvency/Liquidity 2/2/2/1 vs peer-median 3/3/3/3; 1=strongest).

bull_points.claim: Consensus is not capitulating: mean target $144.06 / median $139.00 sits well above the $85.99 close, and ratings skew Buy 9 / Outperform 2 / Hold 9 with zero Sell.

Near-term earnings estimates have firmed, not collapsed: FY26 EPS Normalized revised net +8% (12.1→13.1 over 12m→latest) and the guidance track-record shows FQ1 2026 MET on both revenue and EPS with 63/64 and 66/67 historical floor-beats.

bear_points.claim: EBITDA margin has structurally compressed from 17% (FY21) to 13% (LTM) and gross margin from 34% to 29% — and this is the REAL signal, not an optical artifact: while absolute EBITDA rose modestly, the multi-year margin erosion is a genuine profitability decline in a labor-arbitrage services model, not a % that fell while dollars grew faster.

bear_points.claim: The stock is down 60% over 180 days and -76% relative to the market, with three discrete gap-downs (2026-02-03, 02-19 earnings, 06-18) — a persistent idiosyncratic de-rating, not a market-wide move.

Forward revenue revisions are broadly NEGATIVE: FQ2 2026 Revenue breadth 1↑/14↓ and FQ3 2026 0↑/14↓, and GAAP net income for FY26 is revised net -9% — the trailing EBITDA rise masks a deteriorating forward top-line trajectory.

Analyst target prices have been slashed on initiation/revision (Wedbush 230→99; another 215→110; Truist 146→112) even as the consensus mean stays elevated — a stale-mean-vs-fresh-cut divergence that flags the high consensus target as lagging.

decisive_question.question: Is the collapse in top-line trajectory and margin a CYCLICAL/AI-transition air-pocket that mean-reverts (overshoot), or the start of a SECULAR erosion of the labor-arbitrage services model (value trap)?

evidence_for.claim: Revenue is still growing +7.6% YoY in Q1-26 and +15% in FY25, absolute EBITDA is rising, and forward EPS Normalized firmed net +8% — consistent with a temporary reset, not structural decay.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

evidence_for.claim: Net-cash balance sheet (-1.0x) plus positive LTM FCF and ongoing buybacks give the business time to reset without forced action.

evidence_against.claim: Forward revenue revision breadth is overwhelmingly negative (FQ2 1↑/14↓, FQ3 0↑/14↓) and gross/EBITDA margins have eroded multi-year — the leading indicators point down, not to reversion.
The -60% price and -76% relative move with rising short interest at ~20% of float signal the market is pricing structural rather than transient impairment.

key_unknowns: Adjusted/forward EBITDA and adjusted EPS are UNKNOWN — the 99.1 revised guidance carried no adjusted figure, so the trailing 4.0x cannot be cleanly split into cheap-overshoot vs cheap-terminal.

The 2026-02-19 earnings 8-K carried NO NUMERIC forward outlook and NO revised-guidance 99.1 exhibit was parsed — the absence of a management forward guide at the very event that triggered the de-rating is a bearish disclosure gap, not a neutral one.

Interest coverage is UNKNOWN (no period with both EBITDA and interest expense) and the covenant basis / adjusted-EBITDA leverage basis is UNKNOWN — leaving the covenant headroom on the $700M revolver (max leverage 3.50x) unverifiable.
Segment-level EBITDA is UNKNOWN (Segments sheet has no EBITDA section) — no visibility into whether Americas (58%) or Europe (42%) is driving the margin erosion.
TEV/LTM EBITDA at the 0th percentile of its own history is a NEUTRAL trailing-only fact (cheap-overshoot vs cheap-terminal unresolved) — it must be adjudicated, not read as directional on its own.
The peer set is flagged HETEROGENEOUS (market caps span 106x, $734M–$77.7B) — every peer multiple and the earned-vs-residual discount read is confidence-gated, not a clean benchmark.
Management posture on the two earnings-call transcripts (Q4-25, Q1-26) is on file but un-excerpted — the qualitative narrative on demand, AI cannibalization and margin path must be read directly.
The CIQ export date is unverified (a floor of ≥2026-06-18); the true export is likely weeks newer, so consensus targets/ratings may be staler than the fresh broker cuts already visible.

business_description.value: EPAM Systems, Inc. provides digital platform engineering and software development services worldwide. The company offers engineering services, including requirements analysis and platform selection, customization, cross-platform migration, implementation, and integration; cloud services for creating a roadmap to set and refine IT and business goals while identifying new and emerging opportunities leveraging cloud technologies; data, analytics and artificial intelligence; customer experience; marketing; and cybersecurity. It also offers operation solutions comprising integrated engineering practices and smart automation services. In addition, the company offers software product and platform development services, which comprise product research, customer experience design and prototyping, program management, component design and integration, full lifecycle software testing, product deployment and end-user customization, performance tuning, product support and maintenance, managed services, as well as cross-platform migration and modernizing legacy platforms. The company serves the financial services; consumer goods, retail and travel; software and Hi-tech; business information and media, life sciences and healthcare; and emerging verticals industries EPAM Systems, Inc. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Newtown, Pennsylvania.
